Before joining Pixar in 2003, Mark worked on virtual reality and simulation at Argonne National Laboratory and instructed Computer Graphics courses in the Computer Science department at Caltech. alternates.evidence_quote: Fernando De Goes ... Fernando de Goes is a principal research scientist at Pixar Animation Studios. His research centers on numerical methods for geometry processing and computational physics. He received a PhD degree in computer science from Caltech in 2014 supported by a Google PhD Fellowship. Before Caltech, he attended Unicamp (Brazil) where he earned an engineering degree in 2006 and a master degree in 2009.
